svg.title: Rat · Cream
svg.desc: Large cream laboratory rat with pale wheat fur, lighter ventral surface, pink extremities, robust upright trunk, and substantial tail. Biological basis: Reduced pigment intensity produces warm cream coat tones without altering the large-bodied Rattus norvegicus morphology.
